proof_classes.P1: FORMAL THEOREM: deductive from explicit axioms/definitions
proof_classes.P2: FINITE EXACT: theorem/certificate over a completely enumerated bounded universe
proof_classes.P3: PROBABILISTIC/GENERALIZATION BOUND under explicit task distribution
proof_classes.P4: EMPIRICAL CAUSAL HYPOTHESIS: prospectively falsifiable, not universally derivable
proof_classes.P5: IMPOSSIBILITY/LIMIT: why a stronger universal claim cannot hold

scope: definitions + theorem registry rows are frozen BEFORE any proof/counterexample/bound artifact is produced; lanes may not edit frozen statements, only fill status/proof_artifact fields via amendments
